title: Reflexive Pronouns (magát, magában, magával) in Psychological Narration

sections.title: The Paradigm of maga / önmaga + Definite Conjugation
sections.content: When an action is consciously directed back at the subject's own self, Hungarian uses the reflexive pronoun maga (or its elevated/emphatic counterpart önmaga) declined for person and case: magam(at), magad(at), magát, magunkat, magatokat, magukat. Critically, all forms of maga—including first-person magamat and second-person magadat—are grammatically third-person possessed nouns and therefore ALWAYS trigger the DEFINITE conjugation on a transitive verb: Áltatom magam ('I delude myself'), Megnyugtatod magad ('You calm yourself down'), Kínozza önmagát ('He torments himself').

sections.title: Oblique Reflexive Idioms of the Inner World
sections.content: Beyond the accusative, case-inflected reflexive pronouns anchor key psychological expressions: magába zárkózik (illative -ba/-be: 'withdraws into oneself / shuts oneself off'), magában kételkedik / tűnődik (inessive -ban/-ben: 'doubts inwardly / muses to oneself'), tisztában van önmagával and megbékél önmagával (instrumental -val/-vel: 'understands oneself / makes peace with oneself'). Compare megnyugodott ('he naturally calmed down') with megnyugtatta magát ('he deliberately talked himself into calming down').

sections.title: Reflexive Pronoun Idioms vs. Suffixal Middle Verbs
rows: Hiába áltatod magad, a probléma nem oldódik meg magától. (In vain do you delude yourself; the problem will not solve itself.)
A kudarc után hetekre teljesen magába zárkózott. (After the failure, he withdrew completely into himself for weeks.)
Sokáig magában tartotta a fájdalmát. (He kept his pain to himself for a long time.)
Az idős kapitány végül megbékélt önmagával. (The elderly captain finally made peace with himself.)

items.spanish: Miért kínozod magad olyan gyanakvással, amelynek semmi alapja sincs?
items.english: Why do you torment yourself with suspicion that has no basis whatsoever?

items.spanish: Az ember gyakran még önmagával sincs teljesen tisztában.
items.english: A person is often not even fully clear about himself.

items.spanish: Amikor a felesége rákérdezett az álmára, nem zárkózott többé magába.
items.english: When his wife asked about his dream, he no longer withdrew into himself.

items.spanish: Megpróbálta közömbösnek tettetni magát, de a hangja elárulta az izgalmát.
items.english: He tried to pretend to be indifferent, but his voice betrayed his agitation.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Remember that 'magamat' and 'magadat' require the DEFINITE verb ending: 'Jól ismerem magamat' ('I know myself well', NEVER '*ismerlek magamat' or '*ismerek magamat').
